skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the nature, role, and functions of public relations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Know the concepts, nature, and role of public relations; understand ethical and legal issues in public relations activities.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Organizing public relations activities within organizations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand how to establish and operate public relations activities within a business/organization (Client); understand how external PR consulting companies (Agency) provide services.
Understand the public relations management process: analyzing situations to identify PR issues/opportunities, planning and implementing PR programs; monitoring and evaluating PR programs.
Understand public relations activities with typical public groups: media, internal staff, community, and investors.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Handling crisis management, organizing events, and fundraising activities
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand crisis management, event organization, and fundraising activities.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Writing and presenting skills in specific fields
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand public relations in specific fields, writing skills, and presentation skills.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Writing a PR article for a specific organization/business
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop the ability to write a PR article for a specific organization/business.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing situations to support decision-making and PR solutions for businesses/organizations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop the ability to analyze situations to support decision-making and PR solutions for specific businesses/organizations.
Be proactive in learning, research, and teamwork.
Be proactive in selecting topics and problems.
Be proactive in presenting research results.
